## Flagship Project

### Temporal
- **URL:** https://temporal.khatriutsav.com
- **Description:** A high-performance financial intelligence ecosystem built for "Financial Purity". Combines a Swiss Brutalist aesthetic with on-device AI (Google Gemma via LiteRT) for privacy-first, offline transaction tracking, multi-asset portfolio management, and high-precision data visualization.
- **Tech Stack:** React Native (Expo), Google Gemma (AI), LiteRT, expo-sqlite, NativeWind v5, p5.js, TanStack Query, TypeScript.
- **Significance:** Utsav Khatri's flagship product — an offline-first, on-device-AI finance platform demonstrating applied generative AI outside the cloud.

## Selected Projects

- [Note Sync Pro](https://notes-sync-pro.vercel.app/): AI-powered minimalist blog platform (Next.js, Convex, Google Gemini, Vercel AI SDK).
- [Expense Tracker Pro](https://expense-pro.khatriutsav.com/): AI-enhanced finance management with intelligent categorization (Next.js, Hono.js, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL).
- [Ticker AI](https://ticker-ai-tau.vercel.app/): AI-powered financial ticker with real-time market insights (Next.js, Chart.js).
- [AI Card Generator](https://ai-card-maker.khatriutsav.com/): SaaS tool generating professional greeting cards with AI (Next.js).
- [AI Recipe Maker](/projects): Mobile app generating recipes dynamically with Gemini AI (Expo, React Native).
- [IPO Insights Pro](https://pro-ipo.vercel.app): IPO tracking with Grey Market Premium data and visualization (Next.js, Chart.js).

## Areas of Expertise

- **Frontend:** React.js, Next.js (App Router, RSC), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, Redux.
- **Backend:** Node.js, Bun, Hono.js, Express.js; REST APIs, GraphQL, microservices, WebSockets, serverless (AWS Lambda).
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Convex, Redis, Firebase; Drizzle ORM, Prisma.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Cloudflare (Workers/Pages), Vercel, AWS; CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Docker, Git.
- **AI:** Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, agents, Google Gemini, Fal.ai, Stable Diffusion, Vercel AI SDK, on-device inference (LiteRT/Gemma).
- **Specialties:** SEO / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), web performance, API security, scalable architecture.
